regime: VQ-VAE, 4x downsample, 128px patch -> 32x32 tokens, codebook 512 x 64, EMA updates, 40 epochs, gradient-loss weight 1. Patch pool from src.synth_patches (generator boundary enforced there). The held-out split here is patch-level, for measuring reconstruction only; it is NOT the leakage boundary.
holdout: SAME-SLICE patch-level split: all held-out patches come from slices that also supplied training patches, and crops may overlap spatially. PSNR/perplexity are optimistic by an unmeasured amount. Valid for comparing factors, which share the holdout.
gate_passed_note: `gate_passed` covers the PSNR and perplexity gates ONLY. It does NOT cover the segmenter-preservation check (--segcheck), which is what actually decided this arm; f=8 records gate_passed=true and was rejected there. See spec task 2.
